title: Matryoshker repository config (contract v2)
description: Schema for config/<repo>.json. See docs/data-contract.md, section 3. The pipeline is lenient (unknown keys warn); this schema is strict so editors and CI flag typos.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint; ignored by the pipeline.

repo.description: Display name of the mapped repository. Also part of the viewer's localStorage key mtk:<repo>@<commit>.

commit.description: Commit the map was built from (short SHA recommended). Shown in the header.

date.description: Build/snapshot date shown in the header; ISO YYYY-MM-DD recommended, displayed verbatim.

data.description: v1 alias of "date". Accepted silently; "date" wins when both are present.

lang.description: Viewer UI language. Any other value warns and falls back to "en".

categories.description: Ordered list of categories. The first six non-gray ones get the palette slots in order; later ones share slot 6.

rules.description: Ordered [prefix, category_id] pairs; the first prefix that matches path.startswith(prefix) wins.

fallback_category.description: Category of files no rule matches and that are not tests.

test_path_marker.description: Substring that marks test files. Empty string or null disables the check.

test_category.description: Category assigned when test_path_marker is found in the path.

hop_path_prefixes.description: Prefixes tried, in order, when a cited path does not resolve as written (resolution: exact, each prefix + path, unique basename).

urls_files.description: DEPRECATED (v1). Accepted with a stderr warning and mapped to one django-drf parser entry with route_prefix "" and ignore_views []. Ignored when entry_points is present.

id.description: Category id stored in files[].g. Unique within the config.

label.description: Legend text; defaults to the id.

gray.description: Neutral color (gray slot) instead of a palette slot.

muted.description: Hidden by default; the header toggle reveals it (tests, typically).

rule.description: [path prefix, category id]. End prefixes with '/' so that src/app does not capture src/apple.

items.description: Path prefix, relative to the target repo root.

entryPoints.description: Route parsers to run. Absent or parsers: [] means no parser runs.

parserEntry.description: One parser invocation. Keys other than name and files are passed to the parser as options; unknown options warn.

name.description: Registry name of the parser (pipeline/entry_points/). Unknown names are a hard error listing the available parsers. Currently: django-drf.

files.description: Files the parser scans, relative to the target repo root (joined with prep_extra --repo / build --repo).

route_prefix.description: Prepended to every route label; empty or starting with '/'. A trailing '/' is stripped.

ignore_views.description: A view whose class name contains any of these substrings is skipped.
